rationale: The inline success shape is extracted as AuthorizedApplication so the response has a stable named schema without changing its fields.

object.description: Distinguishes the authorized connect application object.

id.description: The unique ID of the authorized connect application.

granted_scopes.description: The scopes granted by the user to the application.

oauth_resource.description: The OAuth resource associated with the authorized connect application, if one was requested.

provenance.observed: The operation declares its AuthorizedApplication success shape inline at /components/schemas/AuthorizedConnectApplicationList/properties/data/items.
provenance.specd: The SDK exposes the same success shape through the named AuthorizedApplication component.
